commits.subject: core: RunRedirect() on POSIX returns again as soon as the child exits
commits.body:
Since c2f8bb0f5, WaitReadPending() returns -1 when poll() reports only
POLLHUP/POLLERR/POLLNVAL, i.e. when the child closed its stdout and nothing
is left to read. RunRedirect() only read the pipe when the result was > 0,
so it never saw the EOF of a finished child: it busy-looped until
waitfordelayms elapsed, then killed the already finished process group and
returned exitcode = -1 - and with the default INFINITE delay it never returned.

- RedirectOutput() now treats a negative result as the end of the output
- WaitReadPending() now returns 0 instead of -1 when poll() was interrupted
  by a signal (EINTR): otherwise RunRedirect() would mistake such an
  interruption for the end of the output, truncate it and close the pipe
  under a still running child - such interruptions were retried before
  c2f8bb0f5, and still are
- added TTestCoreBase._RunRedirect regression test
commits.author: zen010101
